meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能查你在 Claude-Mem(cmem.ai)里的持久记忆:先用宽泛关键词搜，再用精确词缩小范围，最后用平实语言作答，问「什么时候」时附上时间戳。
howto.when: 当你提到「搜索记忆」「你还记得 X 吗」等说法，或想了解过往会话中关于某项目、决定、文件的上下文时触发。

say.text: 搜索记忆：上次我们改过的登录逻辑
say.note: 返回带时间戳的相关观察记录

say.text: 你还记得我们在 claude-mem 里定过什么决定吗？
say.note: 汇总相关历史观察作答

say.text: 查一下 claude-mem 里关于错误处理的历史记录
say.note: 索引搜索后给出相关条目

howto.what_en: Claude searches your persistent Claude-Mem memory on cmem.ai: broad keyword search first, then exact terms to narrow, and it answers in plain language, quoting timestamps when you ask when.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "search memory", say "what do you remember about X", or want prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search memory: the login logic we changed last time
Do you remember what decisions we made in claude-mem?
Find past observations about error handling in claude-mem
say_en.note: Index search then lists relevant entries
